EaseMyTrip Promoter Nishant Pitti Charged in Betting App Case

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has filed a chargesheet against Nishant Pitti, a promoter of EaseMyTrip, in connection with the Mahadev betting app money laundering case. The ED has also sought to confiscate shares worth Rs 59.6 crore belonging to Pitti. The action is related to alleged betting proceeds.
